newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes up at a eleven-week high vs US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes up at a eleven-week high vs US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up at an eleven-week high of 8.2935 against the U.S. dollar from Tuesday's 8.2940 due to continuing strong pro-yuan sentiment, dealers said.
The weighted average price on Tuesday was 8.2943.
Bids for the yuan were still active today despite the currency's rise over the past three days, indicating investors remain optimistic over its upward potential, dealers said.
The yuan opened up at 8.2940 and fell slightly to hit an intraday low of 8.2943 early in trading. It then moved up slightly above the 8.2940 level, reaching a high of 8.2932 late in the session.
